footer.tagline: A fast, search-friendly website with accounts and an admin area built in.

hero.title: Build something people
hero.description: A fast, search-friendly website with visitor accounts, languages and an admin area already in place, so you can start on what makes yours different.

features.title: Everything a modern site needs
features.subtitle: The groundwork is done and tested, from the first page view to the admin screens.

seo.title: Search friendly
seo.description: Every page is rendered on the server, with titles, descriptions, sharing cards and a sitemap you edit from the admin area.

accounts.title: Visitor accounts
accounts.description: Sign-up, sign-in, email verification and password recovery, with roles and permissions behind them.

languages.title: Many languages
languages.description: Serve every page in the languages you choose, right-to-left included, and edit any text without a deployment.

admin.title: Admin area
admin.description: Manage users, roles, settings, translations and notifications from one place.

cta.title: Ready to begin?
cta.description: Create an account in a minute and see it for yourself.
cta.closedDescription: See what is included and how it all fits together.

about.title: About us
about.intro: We are a small team that builds dependable software for the web. This page is a starting point: tell your visitors who you are and why you do what you do.

mission.title: Our mission
mission.text: To make good websites easier to build and easier to run, so more of every project is spent on the ideas that matter.

quality.title: Quality
quality.description: We would rather ship one thing that works than three that almost do.

openness.title: Openness
openness.description: We explain our choices plainly and share what we learn.

care.title: Care
care.description: Every visitor deserves a page that is fast, clear and accessible.

contact.title: Contact us
contact.intro: Questions, ideas or feedback? We would love to hear from you and usually answer within one working day.
